usedFor: Flow holds tasks and projects, and “Task Completed” there can add a contact or update one in LeadConnector.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Completed” in Flow, then “Add or Remove Contact from Workflow” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A finished task can put a contact into a LeadConnector workflow or remove it, by Contact ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “Task Completed” in Flow is polling, so the contact moves a little after the task is marked done.
